page.overview:
Who is Javindhra Doraille?

Javindhra Doraille is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah and for a while she was a Sitter in the Hall of the Tower.

Javindhra is tall, has smooth cheeks but a very angular face. She speaks with a very harsh manner. She is bony.

Javindhra is of low average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would be unable to Travel without linking with another channeler.

Javindhra is 158 years old. She was born in the year and went to the White Tower in . After spending six years as novice and five as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year . She was elected Sitter in the year 985 NE.
